description: Google partners with Telangana government to develop AI solutions in agriculture, mobility, education, sustainability, and governance for economic progress.
body_lead: Google and Telangana government on Thursday entered into a memorandum of understanding for developing and implementing AI solutions across key sectors, including agriculture, as well as empowering startups and accelerating workforce development. Mobility, education, sustainability and governance will be other areas in which they have agreed to work for harnessing the transformative potential of AI. Fostering innovation, bridging the digital divide and equipping workforce with future-ready skills also form part of the MoU signed in the presence of Chief Minister A.
